description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy Act. No. 48 of 2007, Order under Section 2.
reasoning: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It establishes regulatory rates for various commodities and rescinds a previous order, making it a legal/regulatory matter concerning taxation and economic regulation rather than government personnel, structure, or other specialized categories.
